flagged.title: Context: Tudor Propaganda & the History Play
flagged.reason: The video explicitly teaches that AO4 on the Shakespeare question assesses context and advises students to embed context for AO4 marks, when context is not assessed on this section at all and AO4 is written accuracy (SPaG).

mark_affecting.quote: AO4 is context. This means understanding the relationship between the text and the context in which it was written and received.
Embed context directly into your language analysis for top marks... that is exactly how you hit those top marks for AO4.

flagged.title: Act 5: Peace & Marriage
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes Queen Isabel's famous blessing to the French King, teaching students the wrong speaker for a key quotation.

mark_affecting.quote: Now, the French King does give them his blessing. He expresses this beautiful hope that English may as French, French Englishmen, receive each other.
